description: Data foundation for forecasting: Create migration for consumption_forecasts table, Eloquent model, and 24-month synthetic seeder to provide sufficient historical data for ML algorithm training.
steps: Create migration 2026_10_18_XXX_create_consumption_forecasts_table.php with columns: id, zone_id (FK), forecast_month (DATE), prediction_m3 (DECIMAL 15,2), lower_bound (DECIMAL 15,2), upper_bound (DECIMAL 15,2), model_used ENUM('linear','holt_winters','seasonal'), mae (DECIMAL 8,4), created_at, updated_at. Add UNIQUE constraint on (zone_id, forecast_month).
Create app/Models/Drought/ConsumptionForecast.php with: fillable array, casts for decimal and date types, belongsTo(Zone) relation.

Create database/seeders/ConsumptionHistorySeeder.php to generate 24 months (Jan 2025 – Dec 2026) of realistic monthly consumption readings. Pattern: base consumption 10,000–50,000 m³ per zone (proportional to population), summer peak +20% (Jun–Aug), winter dip -10% (Dec–Feb), random ±5% variance per reading. Total: 5 zones × 24 months = 120 rows in consumption_readings table.
Run php artisan migrate to create consumption_forecasts table.
Run php artisan db:seed --class=ConsumptionHistorySeeder to populate historical data.
acceptance_criteria: consumption_forecasts table exists with all required columns and correct types.
ConsumptionForecast model loads without errors and has Zone relation.
verification: mysql -u root -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aquasecure.consumption_forecasts;" (output: 0, table exists but empty before forecast generation)
